title: Fudge
hookLine: Deep chocolate indulgence with zero mixer needed and instant Cook Mode timers.

items.name: Flour, biscuit crumbs, or condensed milk

steps.title: Line Pan & Prep Base Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Line a loaf pan, baking dish, or serving glasses with parchment paper or chill them in the fridge for 5 minutes. Measure out {eu15_main} and {eu15_but} so your base whips up thick, creamy, and clump-free.

steps.title: Transfer, Smooth Top & Add Garnish
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour or press the mixture evenly into your prepared dish, smoothing the surface with a spatula. Scatter {eu15_sug} and {eu15_dry} evenly across the top and press gently so it adheres cleanly.

steps.title: Melt Base Silky & Chill Firm
steps.instructionTemplate: Gently melt {eu15_main} and {eu15_but} smooth, stir in {eu15_sug} and {eu15_dry}, press into a lined pan (or roll into truffles), and chill 45 minutes until firm.
steps.creatorSecret: Line your pan with overhanging parchment so you can lift the whole block out cleanly.

steps.title: Chill Until Firm, Slice & Store
steps.instructionTemplate: Cover and refrigerate Fudge until completely firm and sliceable. Portion into 9 servings, add any crisp toppings right before serving, and keep leftovers chilled in an airtight container for up to 5 days.

ugcQuotes.quote: Zero-fluff steps + Cook Mode timer nailed it on the first batch!
